summary: This directory manages data streaming interoperability by bridging Node.js stream primitives with Effect-based workflows and providing input normalization utilities to unify data sources for stream processing.
responsibilities: Normalize diverse input sources into standardized stream formats
Integrate Node.js streams into the Effect ecosystem
Manage stream lifecycle and resource cleanup
Convert between stream-based data and buffered memory representations
relationships: Input sources are normalized into standardized streams to enable uniform processing across the pipeline.
Node.js streams are wrapped within scoped resources to ensure they are managed correctly by the Effect ecosystem.
Streams are transformed into buffered data structures to bridge the gap between streaming data and memory-based operations.
designDecisions: Utilize function overloading to handle polymorphic input types.
Implement scoped resource management for automatic stream destruction.
Enforce strict usage of Transform streams for predictable data pipeline semantics.
Abstract data sources through a unified input union type.
